summary: Without RC env or Windows Kits, the build runs a bare rc.exe or windres from PATH; a failing RC panics via unwrap, bypassing the contextual error
evidence: embed-resource windows_msvc.rs:34-36 unwrap_or(Path::new("rc.exe")); tauri-winres lib.rs:541-543 unwrap
failure_scenario: Build host with a rogue rc.exe on PATH runs it at build time. Build-host trust dependency, undocumented in the project.
